title: 第3章 我在屋里造人你却在外面送死第4章 刚死老公就改嫁这寡妇是吃人的
slug: 长生让你延续香火没让你量产仙帝
lines: 江翠萍呆呆地点头，便没有再问为什么。
作为女人。
有些事情要学会闭嘴。
“恭喜仙师。”
“我说过了，不用叫我仙师。”
“好的。长生。”
江翠萍咬着嘴唇，点了点头。
然后有些慌乱地转身去灶台忙活了。
很明显。
她还没有习惯跟李长生相处。
李长生看着少女忙碌的背影，收敛了笑意，走到铜境前。
只见镜中人，剑眉星目，双眸炯炯有神，身体上的老人斑都少了不少。
看起来年轻了不止十岁。
身体机能重塑真是个好东西啊！
李长生喃喃一声。
随后好像想到了什么，眉头皱得深深的。
“麻烦了。”
“这里可是青云宗脚下的安置区。”
“周围的道友都认识我。”
“如果顶住这幅模样出去，恐怕会出事。”
李长生沉思了片刻。
心念一动。
使用系统奖励的技能。
下一秒。
外貌身形迅速产生变化，就像被捏脸一样。
目之所及之处，镜子里英姿勃发的男子，脊背佝偻了下来。
红润的皮肤重新变得松弛，布满了岁月的沟壑。
身姿也透出一股行将就木的暮气。
就连修为也隐藏了起来。
在短短三个呼吸间。
李长生又变回了那个【耳顺之年】的落魄老头。
唯一的区别，就是这个老头的眼睛很亮很亮。
“这就是系统的伪装术和龟息术吗？”
“非常不错。”
“有了这两项技能计不用担心被发现了。”
李长生喃喃一声。
片刻后。
江翠萍端着热腾腾的早饭走了进来。
“长生，吃饭了。”
刚抬头，看到李长生的模样，又是一愣，手中的碗差点都没端稳。
“长生，怎么……”
李长生一脸淡定，走到桌边坐下，接过碗筷，笑了笑：
“翠萍，记住你刚才什么都没看见。你的夫君，就是个行将就木、被宗门赶出来的糟老头子，明白了吗？”
content_en:
Jiang Cuiping nodded blankly and did not ask why.
As a woman.
There are some things you have to learn to shut up about.
"Congratulations, Immortal Master."
"I told you, you don't need to call me Immortal Master."
"Okay. Immortality."
Jiang Cuiping bit her lip and nodded.
Then he turned around in a panic and went to work on the stove.
It's obvious.
She wasn't used to getting along with Li Changsheng yet.
Li Changsheng looked at the girl's busy back, suppressed his smile, and walked to the front of the copper realm.
I saw the person in the mirror, with piercing eyebrows and starry eyes, and the age spots on his body were reduced a lot.
He looks more than ten years younger.
Reshaping body functions is such a good thing!
Li Changsheng murmured.
Then he seemed to think of something, and his brows furrowed deeply.
"Trouble."
"This is the resettlement area at the foot of Qingyun Sect."
"Everyone around me knows me."
"If you go out with this appearance, I'm afraid something will happen."
Li Changsheng thought for a moment.
A thought came to my mind.
Use the skills rewarded by the system.
The next second.
His appearance and body shape changed rapidly, as if his face had been pinched.
Wherever he looked, the handsome man in the mirror had his back hunched.
The rosy skin became saggy again, covered with the ravines of time.
His figure also gave off a sense of dying.
Even the cultivation level is hidden.
In just three breaths.
Li Changsheng has turned back into the down-and-out old man who was in the age of hearing.
The only difference is that the old man's eyes are very bright.
"Is this the systematic camouflage technique and turtle breath technique?"
“Very nice.”
"With these two skills, you don't have to worry about being discovered."
Li Changsheng murmured.
…
After a while.
Jiang Cuiping walked in with a hot breakfast.
"Changsheng, it's time to eat."
Just when I looked up, I was stunned again when I saw Li Changsheng's appearance, and I almost couldn't hold the bowl in my hand steady.
"Changsheng, why..."
Li Changsheng looked calm, walked to the table, sat down, took the bowls and chopsticks, and smiled:
"Cuiping, remember you didn't see anything just now. Your husband is just a dying old man who was kicked out by the sect. Do you understand?"
title_en: Chapter 3 I created a human being in the house, but you died outside. Chapter 4 The widow who remarried just after her husband died is a cannibal.
